rationale: Reference class: formal mobilisation decrees by Russia during the war - one (09.2022) in about 50 months, a monthly rate near 0.02 and about 0.05 over the remaining 12 weeks. Adjusted down: Moscow finances the war with contracts, taxes and a larger budget rather than conscription surges.
key_indicator: Decree with the word mobilisation on publication.pravo.gov.ru

rationale: Reference class: confirmed deaths on NATO territory from Russian drones or missiles since 02.2022 - none in about 55 months (Przewodow 2022 was a Ukrainian missile). The new Black Sea deaths were in EEZs, which do not count, and no government attributed them.
key_indicator: A NATO government attributing a fatal strike on its land or territorial sea to Russia

rationale: Reference class: US posture reviews ending in an announced net cut of 10k or more troops in Europe - rare (2020 announcement of about 12k, later reversed). Options of 25-40k and a review ending in XII keep the probability above that low base rate, but the NDAA floor debate and slipping timelines keep it well below even.
key_indicator: Pentagon announcement of the Europe posture decision

rationale: Reference class: DeepState net monthly gains in the last three months - 63, 124 and 154 km2, none above 200. A constant-rate view gives roughly one month in six above 200 in this regime; Ukraine's local counteroffensive argues slightly against.
key_indicator: DeepState October monthly summary

rationale: Reference class: named PLA exercises around Taiwan 2022-2025 - about 1.5-2 per year, giving about 0.55-0.6 over six months at a constant rate. Adjusted down for the summit cycle and the truce to 10.01.2027, during which Beijing kept Taiwan quiet.
key_indicator: Eastern Theater Command announcement of a named exercise

rationale: Reference class: probability that a front-month price touches a level 20% above spot within about 12 weeks at 40% annual volatility - about 0.3. Adjusted down for backwardation (rolls lower the front month) and futures holding near 100 for weeks despite spot tightness.
key_indicator: ICE Brent front-month settlement after the 03.11 elections and Iran strike decisions

rationale: Reference class: touch probability of a level 20% below spot within about 12 weeks at 40% volatility - about 0.25. Adjusted down because supply constraints persist and EIA expects higher 4Q prices, partly offset by backwardation and a possible Iran deal.
key_indicator: ICE Brent front-month settlement and US-Iran talks

rationale: Reference class: touch probability for TTF of a level 15% above spot within 12 weeks at 45% volatility - about 0.5. Winter, record-low storage and Qatar force majeure support upside, but the market held 70-79 for two weeks, so somewhat below the mechanical figure.
key_indicator: TTF front-month settlement and EU storage withdrawals

rationale: Reference class: EU storage withdrawals from 01.11 to 01.01 in 2021-2025 - roughly 12 to 24 pp, recent years about 20 pp. From about 78-79% on 01.11 the central path ends near 58%, and only the coldest years would push below 55%.
key_indicator: AGSI+ EU fill on 01.11 and December weather

rationale: Reference class: statutory tariff mandates with presidential waivers - more often waived or deferred than applied to third countries, and secondary tariffs under H.R. 5334 on a named country would be new. Some chance remains for India or Turkey given deadlocked talks and the shall wording.
key_indicator: Federal Register proclamation citing H.R. 5334 against a third country

rationale: Reference class: negotiated US tariff ceilings with major partners broken by a new US act within about six months - uncommon; threats (diesel) have so far ended without acts. About 0.1 over the 25 weeks to 31.03.2027.
key_indicator: Federal Register act raising tariffs on EU goods above 15%

rationale: Reference class: MPC decisions at meetings with a new projection when CPI is above the tolerance band and the communique has been hardened - a move follows in roughly half of such cases. Two meetings remain (XI, XII); the fuel price cap lowers October CPI, which argues for waiting.
key_indicator: MPC decision of 03-04.11 with the November projection

rationale: Reference class: ECB hiking cycles - hikes in June and September at projection meetings suggest a quarterly cadence, which points to December; but the ECB stresses no pre-commitment and wages show no response. Somewhat below even.
key_indicator: ECB December staff projections and core inflation

rationale: Reference class: OFAC SDN listings of mainland PRC licensed banks - about one (Bank of Kunlun 2012) in more than a decade, despite many Iran-related PRC listings of firms. Truce to 10.01.2027 argues against.
key_indicator: OFAC recent actions naming a PRC bank

rationale: Reference class: EU Russia sanctions packages - about three to four per year, roughly one per quarter, so about 0.5-0.6 for a 12-week window. Ukraine's envoy calls November more realistic for the sectoral 22nd package; vetoes have often delayed packages by weeks.
key_indicator: Council press release naming the 22nd package

rationale: Reference class: Bank of Russia decisions at key meetings - its own guideline of an average 13.7-14% for the rest of 2026 implies at most a small cut by year-end. Weekly inflation jumped and annual inflation is above the forecast range, so a hold is more likely than a cut.
key_indicator: Weekly CPI and Bank of Russia signal before 23.10

rationale: Reference class: legal follow-up of US-China truce extensions - in 2025 MOFCOM published suspension texts promptly after each agreed extension. Both sides say the truce runs to 10.01.2027, so a text before the 10.11 legal date is the usual pattern; the omission of rare earths in the readout is the risk.
key_indicator: MOFCOM announcement amending the 10.11.2026 date

rationale: Reference class: as for the rare-earth suspension - agreed truce extensions have been followed by MOFCOM texts. The 27.11 date gives more time, but the gallium and germanium ban is a separate instrument not named in the readouts.
key_indicator: MOFCOM announcement on gallium, germanium, antimony

rationale: Reference class: MOFCOM listings of US entities - several per year in 2024-2025, often after Taiwan arms sales, giving about 0.5 for a 14-week window at a constant rate. Adjusted down for the truce: none since 22.06.2026.
key_indicator: MOFCOM unreliable entity or export control list announcement

rationale: Reference class: US relaxation of top-tier AI chip controls for China - the step from H20 to H200 took months and Blackwell has not been licensed. A new permission within 12 weeks would be a policy break.
key_indicator: BIS licensing policy for Blackwell to China

rationale: Reference class: month-on-month change in PRC magnet exports to the US - rises and falls are roughly equally frequent. The August value followed a pre-summit fall, so a partial rebound in the summit month is plausible but not established.
key_indicator: GAC September export data (about 20.10)

rationale: Reference class: proposed trilateral US-UA-RU meetings - such rounds took place only intermittently, with long pauses after Moscow declined. With Moscow saying it has no current plans, a meeting within about eight weeks is below one in five.
key_indicator: Kremlin or Office of the President confirming a trilateral date and venue

rationale: Reference class: Article 4 requests - about eight since 1949, but two in 09.2025, so the recent rate is roughly one or two per year, about 0.2-0.3 for 12 weeks. Adjusted down: Romania and Bulgaria did not invoke it after the EEZ sinkings.
key_indicator: Article 4 request by Romania, Bulgaria, Poland or a Baltic state

rationale: Reference class: wartime agreements between adversaries without direct talks - rare within three months when the latest proposal was rejected and only indirect channels remain. The June memorandum shows deals can come fast, so not below 0.1.
key_indicator: Face-to-face US-Iran round confirmed by both sides

rationale: Reference class: Trump's physical attendance at APEC leaders' meetings - 2017 yes, 2018 no, 2019 and 2020 no in-person meeting, 2025 left before the leaders' meeting. The White House fact sheet promises mutual attendance, but post-election Iran decisions and a partly online format argue against.
key_indicator: White House travel announcement for Shenzhen

rationale: Reference class: in-person Putin-Trump meetings - one (Anchorage 2025) in about 20 months of this presidency, plus one planned summit that was cancelled. Roughly 0.25-0.3 over six months; APEC adds a possible venue.
key_indicator: Kremlin readout setting a meeting date

rationale: Reference class: midterm elections - the president's party lost House seats in about 90% of cases since 1946, and with approval near 32% and a generic-ballot deficit near 7 points it loses its majority almost always. Redistricting gains keep it slightly above the floor.
key_indicator: Generic ballot average and AP race calls

rationale: Reference class: leaders who have communicated only in writing for months - a new recording within the next 12 weeks is uncommon; the constant-rate hazard from a long absence is low. Not lower because a single video would resolve it.
key_indicator: New IRIB or khamenei.ir video or audio

rationale: Reference class: Brazilian presidential runoffs since 1989 - the first-round leader has won almost every time. Lula trails by about 2 pp and the eliminated right-wing candidates endorsed his opponent; polls erred in round one, so not lower.
key_indicator: Datafolha runoff polls

rationale: Reference class: transitional governments promising elections without a date - a fixed date usually comes only after the electoral authority is renewed. The CNE renewal is targeted for XII, leaving about three months for a calendar by 31.03.2027.
key_indicator: Appointment of new CNE rectors

rationale: Reference class: exit of Sahel junta leaders by coup, death or resignation - about 0.1 per leader-year in the region since 2020, so about 0.05 over six months. The retaking of Kidal strengthens Goita in the short term.
key_indicator: Unusual troop movements in Bamako or JNIM blockade of the capital

rationale: Reference class: recovery of chokepoint traffic after closures - AIS counts recover only after a political settlement and with a lag of weeks. With a settlement unlikely by XII and counts at 0-5 a day, a 7-day mean above 40 is improbable.
key_indicator: PortWatch Hormuz 7-day mean

rationale: Reference class: PortWatch daily Hormuz counts in the regime since the war - 23.09-04.10 maximum 5. Only three unpublished days remain and the IRGC route rule tightened, so a reading of 20 is near impossible.
key_indicator: PortWatch rows for 05-07.10

rationale: Reference class: naval blockades lifted without an agreement are rare; the lifting would most likely accompany a US-Iran deal (about 0.12), with a small extra chance of a unilateral goodwill suspension.
key_indicator: CENTCOM or White House statement on the blockade

rationale: Reference class: ACP advisories announcing slot increases - they are usually implemented as announced. The 28.09 advisory sets 33 slots from 15.10; a withdrawal for drought reasons is the only risk.
key_indicator: ACP advisory in force on 15.10

rationale: Reference class: Baltic subsea cable or pipeline damage with an announced investigation - about four to five cases from 11.2024 to early 2026, concentrated in winter. A constant rate of about three per year gives about 0.75 over six months; adjusted down because not every season repeats.
key_indicator: Finnish, Swedish or Estonian police investigation of a cable fault

rationale: Reference class: daily change in EU storage in early October - a 9-day average of +0.22 pp gives 73.05 for gas day 06.10, just above the threshold. Day-to-day injections vary and cooler weather on 06.10 may slow them, so close to even.
key_indicator: AGSI+ value for gas day 06.10

rationale: Reference class: in this war the US struck Iran repeatedly after failed rounds of talks; since 01.09 none. Officials place options after 03.11 and a third carrier group arrives by end-XI; a constant hazard over about eight post-election weeks gives about one in three.
key_indicator: CENTCOM strike statement after 03.11

rationale: Reference class: Fed hike timing - when minutes say another hike is likely by year-end, the Fed has tended to act at the projection meeting (XII) unless data surprise. Weak payrolls (+29k) argue for waiting in October.
key_indicator: September CPI and October payrolls

rationale: Reference class: October injection rates - injections usually slow through October. The current pace of 0.22 pp a day gives about 78.7% on 01.11; reaching 80% needs a faster pace than in late September.
key_indicator: AGSI+ injection pace in mid-October

rationale: Reference class: US strikes on Houthis - frequent in 2024 and 2025 campaigns, none now as the US stays out for now. Saudi fatalities and Camp David options on Yemen raise the hazard; about 0.3 over 12 weeks.
key_indicator: CENTCOM statement on Yemen strikes

rationale: Reference class: quarters with at least 1 bn USD of DSCA notifications for Taiwan - roughly a third of quarters in 2017-2025. Adjusted down because notifications have been held back during summit diplomacy and the truce.
key_indicator: DSCA major arms sales page for TECRO

rationale: Reference class: sovereigns with a negative outlook from one agency - about a third to a half are downgraded within 12-18 months. Fitch A- negative has its next review around II 2027; S&P is stable, so a two-notch-path downgrade there is unlikely.
key_indicator: Fitch review of Poland in early 2027

rationale: Reference class: EU legal acts using Russian central bank assets themselves - none after years of debate; the reparations loan stalled and the EU chose its own borrowing. A new act within nine months needs unanimity or a new legal basis.
key_indicator: Commission legislative proposal on the assets

rationale: Reference class: initialled peace treaties waiting on preconditions - signature often takes years. Azerbaijan's demand for an Armenian constitutional change has not been met, giving about 0.15 over nine months.
key_indicator: Armenian constitutional referendum date

rationale: Reference class: capture of large defended cities at the current front pace of about 60-150 km2 a month - none of this size in 2025-2026. Kostiantynivka, in front of them, is still not taken.
key_indicator: ISW assessment of Kostiantynivka

rationale: Reference class: probability that a price near a threshold is above it 13 days later - close to even (random walk). Brent settled at 100.20 on 07.10 with no clear trend in the window.
key_indicator: ICE Brent December settlement

rationale: Reference class: CPI response to fuel tax cuts - the VAT cut lowered pump prices by about 15% from late September; with a fuel weight near 6% this removes roughly 0.8 pp from the September 4.0%. That points to about 3.2-3.4%, with energy-price risks named by the MPC on the upside.
key_indicator: GUS flash CPI for October

rationale: Reference class: monthly change in the FAO index - rises and falls are about equally frequent, with mild momentum. Cereals and sugar rose strongly in September and energy and Black Sea risks persist.
key_indicator: FAO cereal sub-index

rationale: Reference class: US-China truce deadlines since 2025 - each one (Geneva, August, Busan, September) was extended, usually close to the deadline. Both sides must announce by 10.01.2027; a gap of a few days or one-sided wording is the main risk.
key_indicator: High-level US-China contact before year-end

rationale: Reference class: PortWatch daily Hormuz counts since the war - 0-5 a day in the last 12 published days, maximum 5. A day at 10 or more in a 10-day window would double the recent peak.
key_indicator: PortWatch daily Hormuz n_total

rationale: Reference class: PortWatch daily Bab el-Mandeb counts - 22-37 in the last 12 days, minimum 22. Daily AIS counts are noisy and the shore is contested, so a single day below 20 in 10 days is plausible but not likely.
key_indicator: PortWatch daily Bab el-Mandeb n_total

rationale: Reference class: Houthi strike campaigns on Saudi Arabia - in active phases fatalities were reported every few weeks. The first deaths came on 06-07.10 and attacks continue, so about 0.4 for two weeks.
key_indicator: GACA or coalition statements on casualties

rationale: Reference class: direct US-Iran meetings in this war - a handful of rounds in months, the last on 22.09; current exchanges are indirect via Qatar. A same-room meeting in a two-week window is unlikely.
key_indicator: Qatari or Omani announcement of a joint round

rationale: Reference class: as Q-0026, for 3.5 weeks - Moscow says no current plans, so the short window gives a low probability.
key_indicator: Kremlin confirmation of a trilateral date

rationale: Reference class: Coreper agreements on sanctions listings - almost always adopted by the Council at the next meeting. Adoption is scheduled for 12.10 with 1,646 names; a last-minute veto is the risk.
key_indicator: Council press release of 12.10

rationale: Reference class: probability that TTF is above a level about 2% above spot 13 days later - slightly below even at 45% volatility. Rising trend and cooler weather add a little upside.
key_indicator: TTF settlement on 20.10

rationale: Reference class: capped retail prices follow the daily maximum price, which fell from 7.88 to 7.74 between 03.10 and 08.10; the average sits about 0.02-0.04 below the cap. Whether the cap falls below about 7.73 by 21.10 is close to even.
key_indicator: Energy Minister daily maximum diesel price

rationale: Reference class: EUR/PLN moves over 10 trading days - about 1% standard deviation; a rise of 0.5% from 4.3797 has about 0.3 probability. The window range was 4.36-4.39.
key_indicator: NBP table A on 21.10

rationale: Reference class: MND daily reports of 30 or more PLA aircraft - several times a month in 2024-2025, but none since the summit (peak 23). National Day on 10.10 has triggered activity before; adjusted down for the quiet regime.
key_indicator: MND daily PLA activity report after 10.10

rationale: Reference class: Bank of Russia reversing an easing cycle - rare without a currency crisis; the rouble is stable and the 2027 rate guide is lower. The inflation jump from utility indexation is a known one-off.
key_indicator: Bank of Russia statement on 23.10

rationale: Reference class: timing of MOFCOM legal texts after truce deals - usually close to the expiry date, not a month ahead. The 08-21.10 window is early relative to the 10.11 legal date.
key_indicator: MOFCOM announcements page

rationale: Reference class: presidential compliance with statutory sanction deadlines - often late or waived. A duty on Russian goods is cheap symbolically, but no 10-day notice was seen and a bilateral US-Russia channel is active.
key_indicator: Federal Register proclamation on Russian goods by 21.10

rationale: Reference class: OFAC RUSSIA-EO14024 designations under this administration - a few actions per year, none in the last two weeks. The H.R. 5334 30-day deadline (18.10) raises the chance of some listing.
key_indicator: OFAC recent actions 08-21.10

rationale: Reference class: Houthi strikes on merchant ships during active campaigns - hits every few weeks; at present one attempted attack (04.10) and a focus on Saudi targets. About 0.3 for two weeks.
key_indicator: UKMTO notices on the Red Sea

rationale: Reference class: Bulgarian presidential first rounds - incumbents near 45% of intending voters (Radev 2021 got 49.4%) usually fall just short of 50% among 20-plus candidates. Undecided voters lift her share among valid votes, so not far below even.
key_indicator: Final Alpha Research and Market Links polls

rationale: Reference class: Knesset elections where the polling lead is within 2 seats - roughly a coin toss, and a tie resolves NO. Likud leads the five-poll average (23 vs 22.2) but trails in the latest Channel 12 poll.
key_indicator: Final Knesset polls

rationale: Reference class: wave midterms with presidential approval in the low 30s - in 2006 the president's party lost six Senate seats. Republicans can lose three and keep 50, so the map protects them, but approval of 32% is extreme.
key_indicator: Polls in North Carolina, Maine, Ohio, Iowa, Texas, Alaska

rationale: Reference class: impeachment motions against Iranian ministers - most are never voted on, but some succeed (economy minister 2025). Foreign ministers in wartime are rarely removed; about 0.1-0.15 by year-end.
key_indicator: Majlis presidium referral of the motion

rationale: Reference class: confirmed airspace violations of Poland from Russia or Belarus - several per year since 2022, the last on 23.09.2026. A constant rate of about three to four per year gives about 0.55 over 12 weeks.
key_indicator: DO RSZ statements during mass Russian strikes on western Ukraine

rationale: Reference class: strikes on merchant ships in western Black Sea EEZs - three ships in two days in early October and Russia's declared campaign against cargo to Ukraine; but authorities often cite only fire or explosion. About even over 12 weeks.
key_indicator: Romanian Naval Authority or Bulgarian government statements

rationale: Reference class: announced carrier surges - usually executed, but timing often slips by weeks. Officials target three carriers around Iran by end-XI; one is in the Arabian Sea and one en route, the third is not identified.
key_indicator: USNI Fleet Tracker positions of Roosevelt and Bush

rationale: Reference class: Putin's attendance at summits hosted by China - he has attended nearly all major ones, while skipping APEC elsewhere since 2018. China publicly welcomes him; a partly online format is the risk.
key_indicator: Kremlin announcement of the Shenzhen trip

rationale: Reference class: EU opening of accession clusters after a veto is lifted - intergovernmental conferences are usually held at the December General Affairs Council, but conditions (the Ukrainian minority-rights law, unanimity) often delay them.
key_indicator: Rada vote on the minority-rights law

rationale: Reference class: BIS implementation of truce commitments - the 2025 suspension was published around the deadline. An extension is expected, but publication on or after 10.11 instead of by 09.11 is a real risk.
key_indicator: Federal Register public inspection for BIS

rationale: Reference class: probability that uranium spot rises about 6% at one of three month-ends - roughly 0.3 with monthly volatility near 8%. Spot has been flat at about 89-90 for weeks.
key_indicator: Cameco month-end spot price

rationale: Reference class: as Q-0019 but needing trade prohibitions by 30.11 - the sectoral package is expected in November at the earliest and packages often slip.
key_indicator: Coreper agreement on the 22nd package

rationale: Reference class: scheduled S&P sovereign reviews - outlook changes occur in perhaps 15-20% of reviews, more when the deficit forecast is raised (7.0% of GDP). Fitch is already negative, which raises the base rate.
key_indicator: S&P statement of 06.11

rationale: Reference class: US fuel export bans - none since 1970s-era controls; the threat was dropped on 02.10 after the G7 release.
key_indicator: US distillate stocks and White House statements

rationale: Reference class: Commission infringements against temporary crisis tax measures - rarely opened within months; a warning letter in III was not escalated. Two infringement packages remain before 31.12.
key_indicator: Commission infringement package of XII

rationale: Reference class: US tariff cuts needing notice and comment - implementation usually takes months, and USTR gives no start date. Both sides acting by 31.12 is unlikely.
key_indicator: Federal Register notice on Board of Trade lists

rationale: Reference class: NDAA enactment - signed by 31.12 in 8 of the last 9 years, and the FY2026 act had a EUCOM floor that the Senate draft keeps. A lame-duck session after the election and veto risk lower it.
key_indicator: NDAA conference text in XII

rationale: Reference class: interstate wars of this length - a negotiated full ceasefire in any given nine-month window is uncommon (about 10-15%). Russia's maximal terms and lack of talks keep it at the base rate.
key_indicator: Trilateral talks with a ceasefire text

rationale: Reference class: ratification of bilateral defence agreements needing two parliaments - typically 6-18 months. No timetable has been set, so somewhat below even for about nine months.
key_indicator: Inatsisartut and Folketing votes

rationale: Reference class: Fed changes to FIMA counterparties after political letters - none known; the Fed protects its independence.
key_indicator: Fed reply to the Moolenaar letter

rationale: Reference class: fall of contested Donbas towns at the current pace - such sieges have lasted a year or more. The heaviest fighting is near Kostiantynivka, but Ukraine is counterattacking in the north; about 0.2 for five months.
key_indicator: ISW maps of Kostiantynivka

rationale: Reference class: announcements of US basing in Poland - from Fort Trump (2018) to the Poznan HQ decision (2020) took about two years. The decision is not expected before XII.
key_indicator: Pentagon posture review result for Poland

rationale: Reference class: touch probability of a level 30% below spot within about nine months at 40% volatility - about 0.3. The curve is backwardated (EIA 2027 average 84), but this requires a Hormuz opening.
key_indicator: Hormuz settlement and Brent curve
